sources.title: Qwen3.5 9B Base by Qwen (Alibaba) — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A mid-sized open-weight base model from Qwen that handles both text and images, making it a versatile starting point for fine-tuning or experimentation. As a base model, it hasn't been instruction-tuned, so it completes text rather than following conversational prompts — developers need to apply their own alignment layer. Its multimodal intake gives it an edge for vision-language tasks ...

sources.snippet: ModelScope Qwen / Qwen3.5-9B-Base Qwen3.5-9B-Base is a high-performance multimodal foundation model that merges visual and linguistic processing into a single, unified architecture. It utilises a sophisticated hybrid of Gated Delta Networks and traditional Attention mechanisms to provide high inference throughput and support for an enormous context window of up to one million tokens. sources.title: Qwen: Qwen3.5-9B - AI Model Details & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B, a multimodal foundation model from qwen, demonstrates a strong overall reliability with an 83% success rate across benchmarks, indicating consistent operational stability. However, its speed performance is a notable area for improvement, ranking in the 10th percentile, suggesting longer response times compared to peers.
